description:
***Request for Information Only***


Brookhaven Sciene Associates on Behalf of Brookhaven National Labs is seeking interested contractors to provide capabilities statements regarding the attached Statement of Work for the Electron Injector Complex effort. Those statements should outline relevant experience, overall safety record, schedule and cost performance, quality management, etc. In addition, please provide SAM.gov UEI number and business size status. As a reminder this is not a formal request for proposals as BSA is only conducting market research at this time.


***Request for Information Only***
